raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control for Female, 45, T2D"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and improved glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower body strength + cardio":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Upper body strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Active recovery & core":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Full body + conditioning":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          farmer_suitcase_carry 3x40..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Mobility + metabolic":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
          inchworm 2m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30..45 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 4m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Low-intensity cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 30m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 3m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Restful movement":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower body strength + cardio":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower body strength + cardio":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload week - full body light":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Progressive overload (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower strength focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Core + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4m
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Full body strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          farmer_suitcase_carry 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          box_step 3x12..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x45..60 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 4m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "LISS cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 30m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 3m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower strength focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Thursday training 55m "Full body strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          farmer_suitcase_carry 3x40..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload week light conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking_lunge 2x12..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Intensification & maintenance (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy + conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Tuesday training 55m "Upper push/pull heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x60..90 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Full body power and strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          farmer_suitcase_carry 3x60..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Metabolic conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          box_step 3x12..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x60..90 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 4m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "LISS recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 30m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 3m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Active recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower heavy + conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x4..6 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x12..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Full body strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          farmer_suitcase_carry 3x60..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload & testing":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x5..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 2x5..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 2x3..3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          plank 2x60..60 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m

NUTRITION
  PRINCIPLES:
    - "Moderate calorie deficit: ~300-500 kcal/day below estimated maintenance to support sustainable fat loss while minimizing hypoglycaemia risk."
    - "Distribute carbohydrates evenly across meals (~30-45g carbs per main meal, adjusted to individual tolerance) to reduce postprandial glucose spikes."
    - "Prioritise protein: target 1.2-1.6 g/kg bodyweight per day (divide across meals) to preserve lean mass."
    - "Include low-glycaemic index (GI) carbohydrate sources: legumes, whole grains, non-starchy vegetables, berries."
    - "Prefer moderate portions of healthy fats (olive oil, nuts, avocado) to support satiety."
    - "Consume fiber-rich foods (aim for 25-35 g fiber/day) to aid glycaemic control."
    - "Timing: pair carbohydrates with protein and some fat at each meal; avoid large high-carb meals before bedtime."
    - "Hydration: at least 2 L/day unless contraindicated."
    - "Monitor blood glucose responses to exercise and meals; carry fast-acting carbohydrate (e.g., 15-20 g glucose source) if symptomatic or advised by clinician."
    - "Coordinate major diet changes with prescribing clinician due to metformin and T2D; monitor HbA1c and glucose regularly."
  SAMPLE_DAILY_PLAN:
    - "Breakfast: Greek yogurt (or low-fat dairy alternative) + 30 g oats + 30 g berries + 10 g nuts — ~25-35 g carbs, 20-30 g protein."
    - "Mid-morning snack: 1 small apple + 10 g almond butter — ~15-20 g carbs, protein 3-5 g."
    - "Lunch: Grilled chicken salad with mixed leafy greens, 60 g quinoa, mixed vegetables, olive oil dressing — ~30-40 g carbs, 30 g protein."
    - "Afternoon snack (pre/post workout depending on session): 1 rice cake + 2 tbsp hummus or a small protein shake — ~15-25 g carbs, 15-20 g protein."
    - "Dinner: Baked salmon, 150 g sweet potato, steamed broccoli — ~30-40 g carbs, 30 g protein."
    - "Evening optional snack (only if needed): cottage cheese or 1 boiled egg + raw veggies — minimal carbs."
  ADJUSTMENTS:
    - "If fasting glucose or pre-/post-exercise hypoglycaemia occurs, reduce deficit, increase carbohydrate around exercise, or consult prescribing clinician."
    - "If weight loss stalls for >3 weeks, reduce intake by additional 100-150 kcal/day or increase NEAT and cardio; reassess with clinician if on glucose-lowering meds."
    - "If experiencing GI side effects from metformin, prefer smaller, more frequent meals and discuss with clinician."
  SUPPLEMENTS:
    - "Consider 1000 IU vitamin D daily if deficient (check levels) and 500-1000 mg omega-3 daily for cardiometabolic support after clinician approval."
    - "Protein powder as needed to meet protein targets."
  SAFETY:
    - "Avoid prolonged fasting or very low-carb extremes without medical supervision due to medication and diabetes."
    - "Encourage regular glucose monitoring, especially when increasing exercise intensity or changing diet."
    - "Educate client on recognizing hypoglycaemia and treating promptly with ~15 g fast-acting carbohydrate."

NOTES
  - "Progress load weekly as tolerated; prioritise form and symptoms monitoring."
  - "Encourage consistent sleep and stress management to support glycaemic control."
  - "Refer back to prescribing clinician for medication adjustments as weight and activity change."
